questions.question: What penalty and profit repayment resulted from allegations that a former White House teleprompter operator used advance access to Trump’s speeches to trade on Kalshi?
options: A $25,000 penalty and more than $65,000 in profits
A $107,000 penalty and more than $400,000 in profits
A $65,000 penalty and more than $107,000 in profits
A $400,000 penalty and more than $1 million in profits
questions.explanation: The former operator paid a $65,000 penalty and returned more than $107,000 in profits. The case preceded the order stopping Kalshi’s bets on Trump’s public remarks.

questions.question: Who said, “The reason we lost is the war,” while discussing Republicans’ midterm defeats?
options: Elon Musk
Eric Ueland
Vladimir Putin
JD Vance
questions.explanation: JD Vance blamed the Iran war for the Republican losses, saying, “The reason we lost is the war.”

questions.question: What must happen after House Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries for speaker?
options: The full House must elect him on Jan. 3
The president must formally appoint him
The Senate must confirm him before the new Congress begins
The Supreme Court must approve the nomination
questions.explanation: The party nomination put Jeffries on track to become the first Black House speaker, but the full House must still elect him on Jan. 3.

questions.question: What was the consequence of the Supreme Court rejecting the administration’s effort to revive cuts to research grants tied to perceived DEI programs?
options: A lower court ruling against the administration’s cancellations remained in place
The administration was allowed to resume keyword-based grant reviews
Congress was required to restore every canceled grant
The dispute was transferred to a federal appeals court
questions.explanation: The rejection left in place a lower court ruling that the administration likely violated the First Amendment by canceling grants based on researchers’ viewpoints.

questions.question: What happened to the House-passed resolution directing Trump to end the Iran war or seek congressional approval?
options: It failed in the Senate by a 51-48 vote
It was vetoed after passing both chambers
It was withdrawn before the Senate voted
It passed the Senate by a single vote
questions.explanation: Senate Republicans blocked the resolution, which failed 51-48 after having passed the House in September.

questions.question: Which group of countries was covered by new licensing requirements for shipments of advanced U.S. chips to data centers?
options: Japan, South Korea, India, Australia, and Mexico
Vietnam, the Philippines, Cambodia, Laos, and Argentina
Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, and Brazil
China, Russia, Iran, North Korea, and Cuba
questions.explanation: The Commerce Department’s rule requires licenses to ship advanced chips to data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, and Brazil.

questions.question: What weapons were mentioned in intelligence about a possible Iranian plan targeting senior Trump administration officials in Washington?
options: Biological agents or cyberweapons
Long-range ballistic missiles
A dirty bomb or chemical weapon
Armed drones or cruise missiles
questions.explanation: The intelligence pointed to a possible plan involving a dirty bomb or chemical weapon and reportedly included specific targets and locations.

questions.question: What was the Senate balance after Mary Peltola flipped Alaska’s seat?
options: The Senate was split 50-50
Democrats held a 56-44 majority
Democrats held a 51-49 majority
Democrats held a 54-46 majority
questions.explanation: Peltola’s victory gave Democrats a 56-44 majority after the party flipped nine Republican Senate seats in the midterms.

questions.question: What was absent from the “peace declaration” issued after the Trump-Xi-Putin summit?
options: A warning to the International Criminal Court
Agreements to reduce nuclear arsenals or end the wars in Ukraine and Iran
A pledge to discuss reducing nuclear risks
A statement that nuclear war must never be fought
questions.explanation: The declaration called for dialogue on nuclear risks but produced no agreements on reducing arsenals or ending the wars in Ukraine and Iran. It did not even mention either war.

questions.question: How quickly did Government Accountability Office investigators generate viable terrorist attack plans after bypassing safeguards on four major AI platforms?
options: Within one week
Within one month
Within three days
Within 12 hours
questions.explanation: Investigators bypassed safeguards on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok and produced feasible attack-planning information within 12 hours.
